children: CBOT December wheat (WZ26) may retest a support at $6.63-1/4 per bushel, as a wave C from $6.91-1/2 looks incomplete.
This wave has briefly travelled below its 123.6% projection level of $6.63-1/4. Chances are it may extend into the range of $6.54-1/4 to $6.59-3/4.
The bounce from $6.63-1/4 can be divided into three small waves, with wave c apparently weaker than wave a. The relation indicates a completion of the wave c around $6.71-3/4.
A break above this level may lead to a gain into $6.74 to $6.77-1/4 range. On the daily chart, the market has broken a rising trendline and briefly pierced below a support at $6.68-1/2.
The support may not hold, as the bottom of wave (b) at $6.45-1/4 serves as a target.
